instruction: Configure your GNOME desktop to prefer dark themes by enabling the dark mode setting.

metadata.explanation: Task requires user to access GNOME settings and enable dark mode by setting color-scheme to prefer-dark. Evaluator checks if color-scheme setting contains 'prefer-dark'. Similar difficulty to original theme task, but focuses on color scheme preference.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly extracts GNOME color-scheme setting via 'gsettings get org.gnome.desktop.interface color-scheme' command
check_list metric appropriately uses regex pattern matching to verify 'prefer-dark' value in command output
Expected value 'prefer-dark' is semantically correct - this is the exact GNOME setting value for dark mode
Complete coverage: instruction requires enabling dark mode via color-scheme, evaluator verifies color-scheme contains 'prefer-dark'
No state accessibility issues: GNOME settings are persistent and accessible via gsettings command, no UI state dependencies
Logic flow is sound: postconfig captures command output to file, getter reads file, metric matches regex pattern
